content.title: How To Watch Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella 2026 Headline Performace From Australia
content.text: Pop's favourite girl's girl is making a triumphant return Taylor Swift’s Best Red Carpet Looks0 seconds of 33 secondsVolume 0% Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is back this weekend, and who better to kick things off than our reigning girl’s girl, Sabrina Carpenter? Fresh off dropping the House Tour music video — a Bling Ring-inspired Hollywood heist co-starring Margaret Qualley and Madelyn Cline — the pop princess is headlining Coachella for the very first time, taking the main stage on Friday night at 9:05pm PT, which translates to 2:05pm AEST on Saturday. It’s an earlier slot than most Coachella headliners, who typically don’t close out until well past midnight — but Carpenter has made it abundantly clear she’s more than earned it. In an interview with designer Marc Jacobs for Perfect, she described the set as the most ambitious show she’s ever done, revealing she’d been building it for seven months. “It’s probably the most time I’ve ever had to actually just sit down and talk about a show as I’m building it,” she said. “Most of the time, you’re really quickly thrust into physical rehearsals, but this time around we started this process around seven months ago. So it’s been a long journey. It will be very special.” Image: Getty Sabrina Carpenter making her Coachella debut in 2024. Carpenter previously performed on the Coachella main stage in 2024 — not as a headliner, but at the sunset slot around 5:30pm — the same day her song “Espresso” came out. The significance of the full-circle moment isn’t lost on her. “I got to play that for the first time at Coachella,” she told Perfect. “And now, two years later, we’re back. And I think that’s what makes this show feel really, really surreal: getting to celebrate all the songs that have come after it, and just how many lives they’ve lived since they’ve come out.” Two years on, she arrives as one of the biggest pop stars on the planet — with two hit records, a Grammy nomination hat-trick, and one very well-documented celebrity breakup firmly in the rearview. In the lead-up to the festival, Carpenter has teamed up with Airbnb on a “Sabrina’s Pit Stop” experience in Indio — a candy-coloured fantasy land just off Route 111 featuring sparkly vintage cars, custom slushie concoctions, exclusive merch, and bookable fan experiences. She also teased the set on Instagram with a stop motion video directed at fans, captioned with a “see you tomorrow night at Coachella.” Carpenter headlines alongside Justin Bieber and Karol G at this year’s festival, which spans two weekends across the California desert. For everyone without a ticket who still wants to witness the main event, here’s everything you need to know. Where To Watch Sabrina Carpenter’s Coachella Set Coachella will live stream performances across both weekends on YouTube, including all main stage headliner sets — free to watch from your couch. What Time Is Sabrina Carpenter Playing Coachella? Sabrina Carpenter takes to the Coachella main stage from 9:05pm to 10:35pm PT, which translates to 2:05pm to 3:35pm AEST on Saturday, 11 April. So will Margaret Qualley and Madelyn Cline be joining Sabrina? In 2024, it was rumoured that Taylor Swift would join Carpenter on stage, but she performed alone. While no guests are confirmed, given she’s had seven months to work on the show and is a well-established star in her own right this time round, we could hope for some surprise guests, but we’ll have to wait and see. Ruby Feneley Senior Writer, Fashion + Beauty Ruby is a journalist and editor with a career spanning beauty, fashion, culture and lifestyle. Ruby’s writing can be found across print and digital titles, including Dazed, GRAZIA, The Sydney Morning Herald, The Age, The Australian Financial Review, Refinery29 and marie claire. Now, she loves covering internet subcultures, TikTok trends and astrology (she is a Leo) as much as she loves scouring shopping aisles for the best non-sticky lip gloss and tracking down the perfect pencil for a faux freckle.
